campos.resumoDica: Up to 280 characters, written by you, for readers who have only a minute. It appears above the text.
campos.capitulos: Each line that starts with "## " opens a chapter. With two or more, readers see the table of contents and can read page by page.
campos.convite: Send yours: this post is an invitation
campos.conviteDica: Anyone who wants to can reply with a sentence or an image. The total only appears from 3 people on, and nobody sees a list of who replied.
campos.fonteDica: A link without tracking parameters or the address of a Vale o Escrito fact-check. The post gets the "with source" mark.
campos.fonteRuim: That source is not valid: use an http(s) link without tracking parameters or the address of a Vale o Escrito case.
campos.capaAjuda: The cover appears above the table of contents for page-by-page readers.

cartao.conviteSemTotal: Reply with a sentence or an image.
cartao.ajudaDoSelo: The author said where the information came from.

leitura.erro: Could not open the text right now. Try again.

filtro.rotulo: Hide posts with an undescribed image from the feed
filtro.explica: Only on this device: the server does not know you turned it on. The description is the text a screen reader reads in place of the image.

erros.invalido_resumo: The short version only goes with a long text, up to 280 characters.
erros.resumo_revisar: The short version has something moderation would need to read first. Change the words or remove the short version.
erros.invalido_capa: The cover must be one of the images of this long text.
erros.invalido_convite: The "Send yours" invitation only goes on an opening post (not on a reply, poll or long text).
erros.invalido_fonte: That source is not valid: use an http(s) link without tracking parameters or the address of a Vale o Escrito case.
erros.invalido_vale: That Vale o Escrito case is not online to be cited.
erros.desligado: These options are not turned on yet. Remove them to publish.
erros.semCifra: An encrypted post carries only the text: the short version, the source and the invitation would go unencrypted. Remove them or publish outside the encrypted group.
erros.semFio: A thread does not carry a short version, source or invitation. Publish a single block or remove these options.

barra.expandirAjuda: Open the full editor with what you already wrote (images, poll, who sees it, later).
barra.dica: Ctrl+Enter posts. Before it goes out, the post waits 10 seconds and can be undone.
